intent: An order's coverage window is the date range running from its order date to its delivery date.
notes: Computation authoring exercising the DateRange CONSTRUCTOR (built 2026-06-08) — a computation-only operator that assigns a DATE_RANGE field its sole legal use site. Gold verified (RuleValidator.check over a DraftComputation; the kernel accepts CoverageWindow = DateRange(OrderDate, DeliveryDate)). The order fixture's CoverageWindow is a date-range field; OrderDate/DeliveryDate are dates. Measures whether a cold agent discovers the computation-spec shape (via `schema add`) AND reaches for the DateRange constructor over (futile) attempts to build a range from a comparison.
